description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting control within the WPEFramework project. It declares abstract classes and structs for warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms, including methods for serialization, configuration, and management of warning categories.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning events, with methods for category retrieval, serialization, deserialization, string conversion, and warning check.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, enabling warning event reporting, category info fetching, and category list management.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface for warning categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning of warning category controls.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configure warning category with specified settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a copy of the warning reporting control object.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Report a warning event with an identifier and event information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieve information about a specific warning category.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Add a warning category control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Remove a warning category control from the category list.
